scientific_conclusion.candidate_decision: Do not advance PCDE-PS as the current MICCAI 2027 second-module candidate; do not add groups or tune within E82.1.
scientific_conclusion.basis: G3 is below B0 by 0.5747 pp ACC and 0.6196 pp hard-AUC/BA; it is below G1 by 0.5747 pp ACC and below G2 by 0.1149 pp ACC. G3 gains 0.1510 pp probability-AUC vs B0, but the primary hard metrics do not support a consistent gain. Medical-text replacement and side-swap interventions cause negligible probability changes and zero hard flips. The gate lowers residual magnitude but G3 does not outperform G2.
scientific_conclusion.limitations: Inherited test-as-validation checkpoint selection, pre-CV RFE/standardization, transductive graph and Fold-2 train/test overlap remain; these results are not an unbiased generalization estimate. Statistical evidence is not validated pathology and prompt grouping is not validated ASD/TD knowledge.

engineering_events: Existing E82 run.py hardcoded old /model path; E82.1 uses read-only E81.3 path adapter at relocated /data location.
GitHub unauthenticated REST rate limit; sources retrieved at git ls-remote HEAD via raw URLs with retry after network TLS interruption.

During E82.1 training a separate concurrent session launched experiment81_6_prcl_res with 10 GPU workers. E82.1 launched no E81.6 process and did not modify/control that session. E82.1 worker limit stayed at 10. Wall time and whole-device sampled memory/utilization are confounded by shared GPU/storage contention; per-task torch.max_memory_allocated remains attributable to E82.1.

First independent audit passed Fold1 then stopped at Fold2 relation-pair SHA: audit held-out-label permutation restored state[labels_np] by rebinding rather than restoring the shared NumPy dataset array in place. This contaminated only that audit process memory. Fixed audit finally to restore the original array in place; original data files and all training/Best/Latest tensor states are unchanged. Independent audit restarted in a fresh process; no formal training rerun.

Independent audit found truncated/missing records in 7 original OSSFS JSONL epoch logs: 19 missing epochs. Raw logs and all formal checkpoints are preserved unchanged. Audit-only deterministic replays start from warmup or an existing Best, reconstruct missing rows, compare every retained row in each replay span exactly, and require exact selected Best/Latest bundle and RNG endpoints. Root cause of log corruption is not established; storage contention was observed. No new research group, hyperparameter change, selected epoch change or formal retraining is introduced.
OSSFS errno5 EIO during fsync of mathematically verified audit recovery proofs. Entire formal directory copied to local /model; all copied file SHA256 verified. No formal task rerun.
